target: issuer future midpoint log return in basis points

blocks.B: issuer quote, rest-of-22 weighted quote/coverage, ES quote and verified native-side trade features, relative-time, issuer, session, event/control controls
blocks.C: issuer and rest-of-22 separated cash-stock trade history

fit: pooled ridge; issuer and event hierarchical weighting; train-median missing indicators; train standardization

folds.TEST: all 2024; no refit, rescaling or lambda selection

uncertainty: 2000 resamples of connected event/date components; leave-one-issuer and leave-one-component sensitivity
interpretation_boundary: conditional predictive content at a candidate minute clock; not structural information share, permanent price discovery, or causal ETF leadership
